notes.title: "Feline Forensics" Has Found the Purrfect Publisher!
notes.notes:
[p]G'day, prospective cat-tectives!🐱🔎 [/p][p][/p][p]I'm incredibly pleased to announce that [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2945150/Feline_Forensics_and_the_Meowseum_Mystery/"]Feline Forensics and the Meowseum Mystery[/url] is being published by the wonderful folks over at [url="https://store.steampowered.com/developer/devcats"]Devcats[/url]! [/p][p][/p][p]With their help, the game will be even better, and able to reach plenty more players. They know great cat games, and it couldn't have been more a natural fit. Plus, a percentage of the game's sales will now support cat shelters and charities![/p][p][/p][p]It was over two years ago that I began development on the original prototype for this soft-boiled noir puzzler, and it has been quite the journey since. The game has evolved tremendously, and I know there are plenty of people excited to finally solve this murder turned museum heist.[/p][p]
If you haven't tried out the demo, please do, and stay tuned for the full release early next year![/p][p][/p][p]Cheers, Nobody Crown 💜[/p]
